hero.label: Headless commerce · WordPress + Next.js
hero.body: ComboStore puts a Next.js storefront in front of the WordPress admin your team already runs — one deploy, nine business modules, and the payment methods your customers actually use.

platform.label: The architecture
platform.title: Headless, without the integration project
platform.body: Most headless builds mean stitching a CMS, a commerce API and a frontend together yourself. ComboStore ships all three as one platform — and deploys them as a single Vercel project.
platform.oneDeploy: Storefront and dashboard in one deploy

wordpress.title: WordPress
wordpress.desc: Your team works in the editor it already knows. The ComboStore plugin adds the commerce models, roles and a REST layer on top of it.

api.title: ComboStore API
api.desc: Order logic, stock sync, payment rails and delivery routing run through one API layer — the storefront never touches the database.

storefront.title: Next.js storefront
storefront.desc: Server-rendered category and product pages, incremental revalidation, and a checkout that still works on a slow connection.

features.label: Everything included
features.title: One dashboard, every part of the business
features.body: From the first product photo to the last delivery confirmation — orders, stock, money and customers stay in one place.

orders.title: Order management
orders.desc: Every order from placed to delivered, with status your team and your customer both see.

products.title: Product management
products.desc: Variants, categories and pricing in the WordPress editor, published straight to the storefront.

stock.title: Stock management
stock.desc: Live counts across warehouses, with low-stock alerts before a listing goes dark.

purchases.title: Purchases & expenses
purchases.desc: Log supplier invoices and running costs so margin is a number, not a guess.

delivery.title: Delivery management
delivery.desc: Assign riders or courier partners, print labels, and push live status to buyers.

payments.title: Local payments
payments.desc: Cash on Delivery, bKash, Nagad and Rocket wired into checkout — no plugin stack to assemble.

support.title: Support tickets
support.desc: Questions and complaints in one queue, with the full order history attached.

ai.title: AI content assistant
ai.desc: Draft product descriptions and blog posts in seconds, in Bangla or English.

media.title: Media library
media.desc: Product photos and video in one place, optimised automatically for fast pages.

ai.label: AI, built in
ai.title: Let AI write the first draft, every time
ai.body: Give the assistant a few details and it drafts a product description, an SEO title, or a full blog post — ready to edit and publish from the same screen.

points.descriptions: Product descriptions drafted from photos and specs
points.blog: Blog posts for SEO and seasonal campaigns
points.editable: Every draft stays editable before it publishes

ai.prompt: Write a description for: handloom cotton saree, navy blue, Tangail weave
ai.answer: A handwoven Tangail saree in deep navy cotton, finished with a traditional border and a soft, breathable drape built for everyday wear. Perfect for office, festivals, or gifting.

payments.label: Checkout that fits Bangladesh
payments.title: Get paid the way your customers pay
payments.body: Local payment methods come configured out of the box — there is no plugin stack to license, wire up and keep in sync.

bkash.name: bKash
bkash.desc: Direct checkout integration, no separate plugin to license.

nagad.name: Nagad
nagad.desc: Instant payment confirmation the moment checkout completes.

rocket.name: Rocket
rocket.desc: Mobile banking, configured and ready from day one.

cod.name: Cash on Delivery
cod.desc: With delivery confirmation built into the rider workflow.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: One platform fee, every module included
pricing.body: No per-module licence, and no commission on your orders. Pick a plan by the size of your catalogue and your team — not by which features you are allowed to switch on.

starter.name: Starter
starter.tagline: A first online shop finding its footing.

points.payments: bKash, Nagad, Rocket and Cash on Delivery
points.support: Email support in Bangla and English

business.name: Business
business.tagline: A growing shop with a team behind the counter.
business.note: Billed monthly · two months free on yearly

points.support: Priority support on phone and WhatsApp

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.note: Scoped to your catalogue and volume

points.integrations: Custom integrations and private API access
points.migration: Guided migration from your current store
points.sla: Uptime SLA and a named account manager

notes.hosting: Vercel and WordPress hosting billed separately

cta.title: Your shop, live in days — not months
cta.body: Point it at a domain and deploy. We will walk you through setup, migration and payment configuration.

footer.tagline: Headless ecommerce for Bangladeshi sellers, built on WordPress and Next.js.
